function: Excluded, above_phy: SD3 DRL only decides task offloading (device, satellite, neighbor satellite, cloud); power allocation uses Dinkelbach and computing resources use convex optimization (p. 9, p. 11).
notes: Exclusion above_phy (check 4). The abstract and conclusion speak of joint offloading, power and computing allocation, but the DRL acts only on offloading. p. 11: "the action set includes all task offloading decision factors". The satellite transmit power is solved outside the learning, p. 9: "the Dinkelbach method solves the transmission power allocation", and computing resources by convex optimization, so no physical-layer decision is learned and the exception for learned power control in satellite links does not apply.
